stem: About three quarters of Voltmarkt's known customers have exactly 1 order in the last 12 months. If frequency is scored with NTILE(5) on the number of orders, what happens to these one-order customers?

options.text: They all get F = 1, the lowest score, as the method intends
They are split over F = 1 to 4 in an arbitrary order
They are left out of the scores, since NTILE skips tied values
They all get F = 3, since NTILE gives tied values the middle score
